polls.note: Reported topline; primary release, sample size and fieldwork dates not yet verified. Weighting provisionally assumes n=500 and uses the report date as the fieldwork midpoint. Other 2% is an undivided bucket; OneBC and CentreBC are unknown, not zero. Under Astra's existing method, this poll informs the three named parties; the undivided Other bucket is excluded from the minor-party averages.

warnings: Experimental: parameters are judgment calls. Two retrospective election tests do not establish calibration.
Poll catalogs can contain errors; source disagreement and missing minor-party options remain limitations.
New-party geography, floor-crossing personal votes and turnout are uncertain.
Astra shares polling inputs with the other models; it is not independent evidence.
